fusions.name: Herd Shoulder
fusions.desc: A steady shoulder blow that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 40%).

fusions.name: Front of the Herd
fusions.desc: Rams every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 28 damage. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Warm Stand
fusions.desc: Raises a patch of warmth where you stand for 10 seconds that restores 3 health a second to you and every ally inside it.

fusions.name: Layered Fleece
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%. You also regenerate 1 health a second, permanently.
